message:
You know that moment when you're relying on your phone for everything, and then it decides to die on you? 😅 We’ve had our share of those frustrating instances, like when we were out and about, and suddenly the GPS went dark. It was a gentle reminder that while tech is amazing, we can’t always depend on it. 

That’s why we’ve started keeping a printed map in our go-bag and ensuring our important documents are backed up, just in case. It’s all about being ready for those moments when our devices take an unexpected nap! 

What’s your favorite tip for staying prepared when tech lets us down?
